title: AgentTrace: Execution-Level Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifying the provenance of autonomous LLM agents is a critical security challenge. Existing semantic attribution is easily obfuscated by system prompts, while active watermarking conflicts with schema-constrained tool generation. We propose AgentTrace, an active framework that identifies the foundation model behind a black-box agent via observable execution traces. AgentTrace injects structurally ambiguous probes to trigger tokenization-sensitive serialization failures at rigid tool interfaces. While these initial failures provide coarse-grained separation across model families, the temporal sequence of subsequent repair operations reveals fine-grained, model-specific recovery behaviors. By modeling these multi-step trajectories with lightweight Markov chains, AgentTrace achieves 96.0% attribution accuracy under adversarial identity spoofing. translated_title: AgentTrace：黑盒大语言模型智能体的执行级指纹识别
translated_abstract: 验证自主大语言模型智能体的来源归属是一项关键的安全挑战。现有的语义归因方法容易被系统提示词混淆，而主动水印技术则与受模式约束的工具生成相冲突。我们提出了AgentTrace，这是一个通过可观察的执行轨迹来识别黑盒智能体背后基础模型的主动式框架。AgentTrace注入结构上模糊的探测指令，以在僵化的工具接口处触发对分词敏感的序列化失败。虽然这些初始失败能够在不同模型家族之间提供粗粒度的区分，但后续修复操作的时间序列则揭示了细粒度的、特定于模型的恢复行为。通过使用轻量级马尔可夫链对这些多步轨迹进行建模，AgentTrace在对抗性身份伪装下实现了96.0%的归属准确率。至关重要的是，序列修复建模成功区分了所评估的同家族模型……
tldr: AgentTrace通过注入结构模糊的探测指令触发工具接口的序列化失败，并用轻量级马尔可夫链建模智能体后续的修复轨迹，从而在对抗性身份伪装下以96.0%的准确率识别黑盒LLM智能体背后的基础模型。
en_tdlr: AgentTrace injects structurally ambiguous probes to trigger serialization failures at rigid tool interfaces and models the subsequent repair trajectories with lightweight Markov chains, achieving 96.0% attribution accuracy in identifying the foundation model behind black-box LLM agents under adversarial identity spoofing.
